Title: A couple of questions about Rabbat, The Sewer Goddess

Messages.Author: Borris
Messages.Body:
Possibly a couple of simple questions but I would appreciate some clarfication:

Q1: Can Rabbat (an Independent Nosferatu) play and/or be targerted to receive the Nosferatu Justicar title, with the Nosferatu Justicar political action, even though she is not a Camarilla Nosferatu?

Q2: Can Rabbat's special strike (sending a vampire to torpor/ burn an ally) be used at long range?

Many thanks,
Borris

Rabbat, The Sewer Goddess
Nosferatu
Capacity: 7
Group: 4
Independent. Red List: Rabbat may send a vampire to torpor or burn an ally as a strike. If she hunts, you may move 1 of the blood she gains to your pool. She cannot take  actions or block actions that aren't directed at her or at a card on her.

Nosferatu Justicar
Political Action
Title.
Choose a ready Nosferatu. If this referendum is successful, put this card on the chosen Nosferatu to represent the unique Camarilla title of Nosferatu Justicar. In this referendum, each Nosferatu gets 1 extra vote.

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
no and no.

The target would not be legal for a camarilla title.

And a ranged strike is written "Ranged: blah" or "XR" for "X Ranged damage"

But she would have 1 vote in the referendum called on a camarilla nosferatu.

Edit : it seems reading card text that she could call the vote but not be the target.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Borris wrote:
> Q1: Can Rabbat (an Independent Nosferatu) play and/or be targerted to receive the Nosferatu Justicar title, with the Nosferatu Justicar political action, even though she is not a Camarilla Nosferatu?
>
No. You have to be Camarilla to receive a Camarilla title.

> Non-existant user wrote:
> A vampire must belong to the appropriate sect to receive a title.
>
> Borris wrote:
> Q2: Can Rabbat's special strike (sending a vampire to torpor/ burn an ally) be used at long range?
>
Rabbat could choose it as her strike, sure. However, the strike would be ineffective at long range, just the same as any other non-ranged offensive strike, like striking for hand damage, striking to steal equipment etc.

Messages.Author: Borris
Messages.Body:
Thanks for the quick answers.
Could Rabbat play the Nosferatu Justicar Political action, targeting a camarilla nosferatu?

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
yes I think so. there is no requirement on the card.

A tupdog could also play it if i am not mistaken.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
If there is an eligible target (== a Camarilla Nosferatu), Rabbat can indeed play Nosferatu Justicar.

Apart from that, correct answers from Timo and jamesatzephyr:
- Rabbat cannot, as long as she's not Camarilla, receive a {Camarilla} Justicar title.
- Rabbat's strike isn't ranged, so it has no effect on the opponent if used at long range.
